title: 第二十三   雨族封侯
content_zh:
若说上次化为血灵的后遗症，还可以说过去。

    这次却是实打实的睡着，他记得很清楚，在献和四时剑走后，他们觉得有必要，将消息带回墨城，就开始返程，芊芊非要一路跟过来。

    经过几个月的相处，他们对芊芊说的话，虽还是半信半疑，却没有像以前那么防备。

    从她的所作所为和谈吐中，猜出她是一个与家里闹矛盾，负气离家的小女生。何况墨城本身就是个普通人可以都可以自由进出的城池。

    与普通城池唯一的差别，就是墨城是墨家自己修筑打造的城池。在兼爱思想的指引下，墨城对人员进入的管理几乎不设限制。

    在经过一天的赶路后，墨攻行当仁不让的先睡，墨非夜则靠就在树干上，负责晚上的警戒，本来在旁边的芊芊，就非要挤过来，要和她的夜在一起。

    没一会，墨非夜就觉得困意袭来，实在扛不住的情况下，就小眯了一会。正常的情况下，墨非夜马上就会被噩梦闹醒。

    可当他再睁开眼睛的时候，天都已经亮了。

    “快快，好好想想，到底做梦了没有。”墨攻行看起来比墨非夜还要激动。

    墨非夜摇摇头，他何止没做梦，好像连动都没动一下，双手抱剑是他休息时候，最常用姿势。

    他之所以喜欢抱着剑，是因为在噩梦惊醒的瞬间，感到无比的安全。

    “是不是你忘记了？”墨攻行刚问出口，自己就否决了这个答案，墨非夜以前醒来是什么样子，他非常清楚。

    这次是在他眼皮下醒过来，完全没有一点异样。

    墨攻行激动地抓住墨非夜的双臂：“你的梦魇消失了？”

    “可能吧？”墨非夜自己也不敢确定。

    “试试不就知道了。”芊芊发表了意见。

    一句话点醒了所有人，“对哟，试试不就知道了。”

    随着太阳的慢慢升起，白霜纷纷隐去，烟消雾散，有些许朦胧的大地也变得清晰起来。

    墨非夜靠在树上，墨攻行和芊芊两个人，大眼瞪小眼地注视着他。

    “你睡着了吗？”

    “你还没睡着？”

    “你还没睡着吗？”

    “你这样问，谁睡得着？”墨攻行有点心力交瘁的感觉。

    “可是人家忍不住嘛。”芊芊委屈道。

    “走吧。”墨非夜站了起来，排了排身上的灰土。

    “要不，我把你打昏试试？”芊芊追了上去。

    今天几人运气不错，准备歇息的时候，路旁正好出现一座破屋，虽已经千疮百孔破烂不堪，可也比在外面露天要强。
content_en:
If we talk about the sequelae of turning into a blood spirit last time, it can be said to be in the past.

    This time, he actually fell asleep. He remembered clearly that after Xianhe and the Four Seasons Sword left, they felt it was necessary to bring the news back to Mo City and started to return. Qianqian insisted on following them all the way.

    After several months of getting along, they were still half-trusting of what Qianqian said, but they were not as defensive as before.

    From what she did and said, I guessed that she was a little girl who had conflicts with her family and left home in anger. What's more, Mo City itself is a city that ordinary people can enter and exit freely.

    The only difference from ordinary cities is that Mo City is a city built by the Mohists themselves. Under the guidance of the idea of ​​universal love, Mocheng has almost no restrictions on the management of personnel entry.

    After a day of traveling, Mo Gongxing went to bed first without hesitation, while Mo Feiye leaned against the tree trunk and was responsible for keeping watch at night. Qianqian, who was originally next to her, insisted on pushing over to spend the night with her.

    After a while, Mo Feiye felt sleepy coming over him. When he couldn't bear it anymore, he squinted for a while. Under normal circumstances, Mo Feiye would be awakened by nightmares right away.

    But when he opened his eyes again, it was already dawn.

    "Quickly, think carefully, are you dreaming?" Mo Jingxing looked even more excited than Mo Feiye.

    Mo Feiye shook his head. Not only was he not dreaming, he didn't seem to even move. Holding the sword with both hands was his most common posture when resting.

    The reason why he likes to hold the sword is because he feels extremely safe when he wakes up from a nightmare.

    "Have you forgotten?" As soon as Mo Jinxing asked, he rejected the answer. He knew very well what it was like when Mo Feiye woke up before.

    This time I woke up under his eyes, and there was nothing strange at all.

    Mo Gongxing grabbed Mo Feiye's arms excitedly: "Your nightmare disappeared?"

    "Maybe?" Mo Feiye himself wasn't sure.

    "You'll know if you try it." Qianqian expressed her opinion.

    One sentence woke everyone up, "Yes, you will know if you try it."

    As the sun slowly rises, the white frost disappears, the smoke disappears, and the slightly hazy land becomes clear.

    Mo Feiye leaned against the tree, while Mo Jinxing and Qianqian stared at him with big eyes and small eyes.

    "Are you asleep?"

    "You're not asleep yet?"

    "Aren't you asleep yet?"

    "You ask, who can sleep?" Mo Gengxing felt a little exhausted.

    "But I can't help it." Qianqian said aggrievedly.

    "Let's go." Mo Feiye stood up and wiped away the dust from his body.

    "How about I knock you unconscious?" Qianqian chased after him.

    A few people were lucky today. When they were about to take a rest, a broken house happened to appear on the side of the road. Although it was full of holes and dilapidated, it was still better than being outside in the open air.
